doc.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023

title: Current projects with lyricist Georgia Mancio
summary: He is going to London to make a second album of his songs with lyrics by Georgia Mancio.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Wow. This has been a very fascinating conversation Mr. Broadbent, and I appreciate your time. Do you have a project to work on when we sign off? What are you working on right now?

Well you know I have, over many years I’ve written standard songs, I’ve loved them. But they’re in my own vein and they’re standard songs. They don’t belong anywhere out of — but there’s a wonderful singer and lyricist in England, in London, Georgia Mancio, Italian-English. And she writes really, really nice stuff and we’ve sort of hit it off and about almost 50 of my songs over the years she’s written lyrics to. So we’re going to do a second album in about two weeks. I’m going over there.
I wonder if one of those songs might be the melody from the Second Movement of your “Developing Story”?
Oh that’s interesting, yeah. But that’s more of an instrumental melody you know?
I can hear someone singing it.
Oh thank you very much, Monk. I appreciate it.
